## Problem and outcome

Observable trigger, resulting behavior, and acceptance case. Link the issue or
execution plan for cross-boundary/multi-session work.

## Design and maintenance cost

Owning module and alternatives considered. Explain new packages, dependencies,
interfaces, durable state, or wrappers; identify the old path removed or its
bounded compatibility/removal plan. Use the change report to account for growth.

## Verification

Exact commands, relevant failure/recovery cases, and results. Distinguish mocks,
real integration checks, live-model evaluation, and any skipped/unverified scope.

## Compatibility and operations

Protocol/schema/policy changes and migration/rollout order, or "none" with a
brief reason. Do not treat passing CI as authorization to deploy.
